text:
anya: noticed inconsistent routing for tenant=acme-analytics; ~60% of requests are hitting fallback-pool even though route priority should pick low-latency pool.

anya: decision logs missing for many of those requests, so we can't see why the rule picked fallback.

anya: sample of request headers:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.dev
X-Tenant: acme-analytics
X-Request-Id: req_8f3a9b
User-Agent: acme-sdk/2.1
```

anya: console shows decision_log_sampling=0.01 for that tenant, but our intended config is 0.05. did something change in the sampling rollout?

mike: do you have a correlator id from the failure? I can check the router traces.

anya: req_8f3a9b is one. I also grabbed a full gateway trace with headers attached.

mike: looking at traces — I see evaluatePrefilterSampler returned "drop" for many of the requests before header normalization. That sampler uses raw headers; the X-Tenant casing mismatch could cause it to drop.

cheng: correct — we recently refactored header normalization (https://go/infra/route-headers) to run after prefilter samplers to reduce perf impact. unintended consequence: tenant-derived samplers that relied on normalized header keys now under-sample.

olivia: oof. any quick mitigation?

sam: short-term: you can flip admin override to force decision-log sampling on for the tenant:
```
POST /admin/tenants/acme-analytics/overrides
{ "decision_log_sampling": 0.1 }
```
This will force logs irrespective of prefilter decision.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T14:22:01Z — //deploys/router-refactor — sha=abc123 applied to canary.

mike: patch idea: move header normalization before prefilter sampler, or change sampler to check both raw and normalized keys. Moving normalization adds tiny latency.

cheng: plan: change sampler to use canonicalizeHeaderLookup(headerMap) and keep normalization cost local to sampler. I'll open PR to check both keys for 48h rollouts.

anya: thanks. enabled admin override; re-ran the failing path and now decision logs show up for req_8f3a9b and a few others :thumbsup:

anya: sample decision log snippet:
```
{ "request_id": "req_8f3a9b", "route": "low-latency-pool", "evaluations": ["prefilter:allow","priority:low-latency"] }
```

olivia: can we add an automated check in infra-e2e to ensure samplers still see tenant header when raw vs normalized casing differs?

cheng: yea, adding tests + a canary configuration to flip on moved-normalization in prod gradually.

sam: documented mitigation in #eng-platform-runbooks and created incident PR: https://git.redwood/infra/issue/4521

anya: next steps: cheng PR, temporary admin override removal after 24h, add e2e, update rollout notes. thanks all.
